content.text: {"sentences":[{"text":"Product wanted to launch card payments on a fixed date for a campaign, but the fraud checks weren't finished.","cites":[{"id":"s-launch","quote":"Product wanted to launch card payments on a fixed date for a campaign, but the fraud checks weren't finished."}]},{"text":"I was the engineer responsible for the payment flow, so I pushed back on the launch date.","cites":[{"id":"s-launch","quote":"I was the engineer responsible for the payment flow."},{"id":"s-launch","quote":"Pushing back the card payments launch."}]},{"text":"I wrote down what could go wrong without the fraud checks and went through it with the product manager.","cites":[{"id":"s-launch","quote":"I wrote down what could go wrong without the fraud checks and went through it with the product manager."}]},{"text":"We agreed to launch one week later.","cites":[{"id":"s-launch","quote":"We agreed to launch one week later."}]}],"followUps":[]}
